answer: Onyx-sealed dawn muster with relic-chain provenance. Each identity mints one relic by locking 250 POA behind a hardware key, with its custody chain on-ledger. Every dawn, a random staked peer assigns a live task due in 45 minutes quoting that morning's Greenwich sunrise time; the reply needs 2 staked-peer countersignatures. One miss burns 70 POA plus a 45-day freeze; a second miss slashes the full 250 POA with a 150-day ban. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 250,000 POA, 1,000 keys at $40 each, and 1,000 dawn tasks a day, like a lighthouse keeper who lights the lamp each dawn or loses the post.
